THE ORCHESTRATOR. run_full() calls every stage in order and returns one bundle; it resolves each stage module and data file by name (_find) so a missing file fails loudly instead of silently defaulting. Everything else in this table is reached from here.

Stage 0. Sample intake and chain of custody: IDAT arrival, manifest creation, identity checks. Built step by step against the SOP; four QC checks are still deferred because Stage 0 is not yet handed the raw intensities (open item, row 0).
Pure-Python IDAT to beta - needs only idat_parse plus a static array manifest, no methylprep or minfi at runtime. This is what lets a reader reproduce Stage 1 without the R/Bioconductor stack.
Low-level IDAT binary reader used by Stage 1 when methylprep is not driving the parse.
Stage 1. Raw Illumina IDAT pair -> beta per CpG (methylprep, noob background/dye correction). The only step that touches instrument output.
Stage 2. Constrained non-negative least squares: which cell types are present and in what fraction. Sparse by design - it reports only what it has evidence for.
Helper for Stage 2b: splits a lineage signal across its member entries.
Stage 2b. The second, independent solver (inverse-variance weighted, atlas posterior SD as the weight). Reported ONLY as an agreement flag at class level, never as the composition.
Stage 4.5. Splits a departure into its hyper- and hypo-methylated halves, so direction is reported rather than magnitude only.
Builds the CpG -> pixel mapping from the array manifest in genomic order. Deterministic: same atlas + manifest -> byte-identical output.
One-time generator for the mapping: lays the CpGs on the sphere in genomic order so every patient projection sits on the same grid as the archival plates.
Stage 4.6. The patient's sky: residual z per CpG against the sample's own composition expectation, on the laboratory's zero and scale, projected onto the sphere in genomic order.
THE ONLY tier function. Reads tier_breakpoints.json; the engine previously carried three disagreeing definitions. Returns no tier when a reading is not reportable, and.
The A-score itself: A = mean_i H(beta_i) / H_min(class). Asserts against the wrong aggregation (entropy of the mean beta), which is the defect PROC-N7-01 caught.
The eight frozen H_min floors and the per-substrate table. Each cell is divided by the floor of its class; nothing else reads the class.

FOREIGN-CELL DETECTOR v3 (PROC-STAGE2D-03, 2026-09-27): one joint NNLS of the panel markers on blood + 21 templates; per-template noise floor = 0.99 quantile over 732 healthy arrays; standing bias and measured detection limit per template; gastric-undiff NOT DETECTABLE. v1/v2 (blood-first, residual projection) retired: they absorbed real foreign material and were commissioned on a circular spike.
Which atlas cell types are collinear - i.e. which ones the reference cannot fully separate. Directly relevant to per-cell reporting: entries inside one group should not be scored against each other.
